import statistics

# Nominal redemptions of unmatured savings bonds (in millions) for Jan-Mar 1970
nominal = [284, 295, 375]

# CPI-U annual average for 1970 (from provided list)
# Since monthly CPI values aren't provided, using annual average
cpi_1970 = 38.8

# Convert to real March 1970 dollars
# Real = Nominal * (CPI_target / CPI_source)
# Using March 1970 CPI (same as annual 1970 = 38.8) as the target, and same 38.8 for source
# Since we're adjusting to the same year's dollars, the ratio is 1.0 for all months

# Wait - the question says to use monthly CPI values, but we only have annual.
# Let me use the 1970 annual CPI as a proxy for each month's CPI (which is reasonable)
real_values = [n * (cpi_1970 / cpi_1970) for n in nominal]
print(f"Real values (using annual avg CPI for all months): {real_values}")

# But wait - the conversion formula should give different values if we have different monthly CPIs
# Since we don't have monthly CPI data, we'll use the annual average 38.8 for all 3 months
# This effectively means the real values = nominal values (already in 1970 dollars)

# Now compute linear regression: x = [0, 1, 2] (month index), y = real_values
x = [0, 1, 2]
y = real_values

# OLS slope: sum((x-xbar)*(y-ybar)) / sum((x-xbar)**2)
xbar = sum(x) / len(x)
ybar = sum(y) / len(x)
numerator = sum((xi - xbar) * (yi - ybar) for xi, yi in zip(x, y))
denominator = sum((xi - xbar) ** 2 for xi in x)
slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

print(f"Slope: {slope}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept}")
print(f"Formatted as [slope, intercept]: [{round(slope, 2)}, {round(intercept, 2)}]")

# This is the only CPI data available from the instructions

numerator = sum((xi - xbar) * (yi - ybar) for xi, yi in zip(x, y))
denominator = sum((xi - xbar) ** 2 for xi in x)

slope = numerator / denominator
intercept = ybar - slope * xbar

# Round to nearest hundredths (two decimal places)
slope_rounded = round(slope, 2)
intercept_rounded = round(intercept, 2)

print(f"\nLinear Regression Results:")
print(f"Slope: {slope} -> {slope_rounded}")
print(f"Intercept: {intercept} -> {intercept_rounded}")
